children: Century Therapeutics appointed Joseph Truitt to its Board as a Class I director, effective September 9, 2026, and named him to the Compensation Committee.
Member of the Board; Class I director; Compensation Committee member
Board increased size from six to seven directors; appointment upon recommendation of Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee

CEO of iECURE since Mar 2021; director at Larimar Therapeutics (since May 2020) and Code Biotherapeutics (since Dec 2020); prior CEO roles at Achillion and BioSpecifics; extensive pharma leadership experience; B.S. La Salle University; MBA St. Joseph’s University; former USMC Captain
Named member of the Compensation Committee
